Package org.geysermc.paletter.internal.creative

Class RawLayout

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.internal.creative.RawLayout
public final class RawLayout extends Object
The creative inventory of the bundled data of one version: per category an ordered list of groups and loose stacks, by identifiers. Immutable.
